data.power_matrix_layout: Outer row follows optical_path_lengths_cm;inner column follows wavelength_order. References are independently measured incident spectral powers in matching arbitrary linear power units,not absorbance or normalized transmittance.
data.species_model: Only the ideal reversible equilibrium 2M⇌D is admitted over the stated analysis range. Total analytical concentration counts monomer units,so a dimer contributes two units. Define the association constant K=[D]/[M]^2 with concentrations in mol/L. Different wavelengths share exactly the same equilibrium species amounts. No photodegradation,higher aggregates,scattering or excited-state population is part of this controlled chemical model.
data.independent_spectroscopic_anchor: At lambda01,the monomer decadic molar absorption coefficient is independently 10000 L/(molcm),and dimer absorption is exactly zero by the explicit controlled spectral model. This selectivity is stipulated independently;it is not inferred merely from having two wavelengths. At lambda02,both species coefficients are unknown and must be inferred.
data.qualification_policy: Use a concentration level only if BOTH wavelengths satisfy relative agreement of path-normalized decadic absorbance:abs(A_short/l_short-A_long/l_long)/mean(A_short/l_short,A_long/l_long)<=0.005. Detector-limited records may be present,but the exact source/model cause of a rejected level need not be identified. Use all qualified concentration levels;either a qualified path or their mean may be used after the control. Passing this finite paired-path check is an operational qualification,not proof against every common-mode instrumental error.
data.scope: Exact controlled small-molecule optical/equilibrium observations with finite numerical reporting. No real dye parameters,experimental degradation claim or new measured chemical equilibrium constant is supplied.

provenance.kind: controlled computational analytical study, not experimental measurements
provenance.generation: Controlled computational input table for the stated study; not experimental measurements. Authentic source inputs are documented separately when present.
provenance.units: Concentrations mol/L;paths cm;decadic molar absorption coefficients L/(molcm);K association L/mol;monomer-unit fraction in dimers dimensionless;relative spectral power units cancel in the measured ratio.
